title.en: Where Does Electricity Come From?

content.zh: 发电厂里，烧煤、用水力、用风或者核能把机器带动起来，机器一转就能发出电。电沿着电线一路跑到家里的插座。
content.en: In a power station, coal, water, wind or nuclear energy turns a machine, and the turning makes electricity. It travels along wires to the sockets at home.

title.en: Why Should We Save Electricity?

content.zh: 发电要烧煤、烧气，会产生让地球变暖的气体，资源也是用一点少一点。随手关灯、拔掉不用的插头，就是在节约。
content.en: Making electricity burns coal or gas, which warms the planet and uses up resources. Switching off lights and unplugging things saves power.

title.en: How Do Solar Panels Make Electricity?

content.zh: 太阳能板里有一种特别的材料，太阳一照就能把光直接变成电。阴天和晚上发得少，所以要配着蓄电池一起用。
content.en: Solar panels hold a special material that turns light straight into electricity. They make less on cloudy days and at night, so batteries are used too.

title.en: How Do Wind Turbines Make Power?

content.zh: 风推着叶片转起来，转动的力带动里面的发电机，就能发出电。风越大、叶片越长，发出来的电就越多。
content.en: Wind pushes the blades round, and the turning drives a generator that makes electricity. Stronger wind and longer blades mean more power.

title.en: Why Should We Sort Our Rubbish?

content.zh: 分好类的垃圾能变成新东西：纸再造成纸，玻璃熔了再做玻璃。混在一起就不好用了，只能埋掉或烧掉，白白浪费。
content.en: Sorted waste becomes new things: paper into paper, glass into glass. Mixed together it is hard to use, so it is buried or burned and wasted.

title.en: Why Are Plastic Bags Bad?

content.zh: 塑料袋几百年都不烂，埋在地里挡住水分，掉进海里会被动物误当成食物。用布袋或篮子，能反复用上很多次。
content.en: Plastic bags last for centuries. Buried, they block water; in the sea, animals mistake them for food. Cloth bags and baskets can be used again and again.

title.zh: 为什么南极的冰在融化
title.en: Why Is Antarctic Ice Melting?

content.zh: 地球越来越暖，南极的冰化得比新雪积得还快。冰化成水流进海里，海平面就会慢慢升高，海边的地方会被淹。
content.en: As Earth warms, Antarctic ice melts faster than new snow builds up. The meltwater raises sea levels, slowly flooding coastal places.

title.en: Why Should We Plant Trees?

content.zh: 树会吸走空气里让地球变暖的气体，放出氧气；树根还能抓住泥土，不让雨水冲走。树多了，空气好、水土也保得住。
content.en: Trees absorb the gas that warms the planet and give out oxygen. Their roots hold soil so rain cannot wash it away. More trees mean cleaner air and safer ground.

title.en: Why Is Car Exhaust Harmful?

content.zh: 汽车烧油排出的尾气里有一氧化碳、氮氧化物这类有害的东西，会让人不舒服，也会让地球变暖、天空变灰。
content.en: Exhaust from burning fuel contains harmful substances such as carbon monoxide and nitrogen oxides. They make people ill, warm the planet and grey the sky.

title.en: How Does a Dam Make Electricity?

content.zh: 水坝把河水拦起来，水位变高。放水时水从高处冲下来，冲动水轮机，水轮机再带动发电机，就发出了电。
content.en: A dam holds river water back so the level rises. When released, the falling water spins a turbine, which drives a generator and makes electricity.

title.en: Why Is Earth Getting Warmer?

content.zh: 烧煤、烧油会放出二氧化碳，它像一层被子盖住地球，把热量留在里面散不出去。被子越厚，地球就越暖。
content.en: Burning coal and oil releases carbon dioxide, which acts like a blanket around Earth, keeping heat from escaping. The thicker the blanket, the warmer the planet.

title.en: Why Should Batteries Be Recycled?

content.zh: 电池里含着一些有毒的金属，随便扔会渗进土里和水里，害了庄稼也害了我们。回收能把它们拿出来重新使用。
content.en: Batteries contain toxic metals. Thrown away, they leak into soil and water, harming crops and people. Recycling recovers them for reuse.

title.zh: 电器不拔插头为什么也费电
title.en: Why Do Plugged-in Devices Still Use Power?

content.zh: 关掉开关只是让电器“睡着”，里面的小零件还在等着被唤醒，一直在偷偷用电。彻底关掉或拔掉插头才不费。
content.en: Switching off only puts a device to sleep. Parts inside stay ready to wake and keep drawing a trickle of power. Only switching off at the socket truly stops it.

title.zh: 空调为什么建议开 26 度
title.en: Why Is 26°C Recommended for Air Conditioning?

content.zh: 26 度既凉快又不会让室内外温差太大，人不容易感冒，空调也不用拼命运转。每调低一度，耗电就多不少。
content.en: 26°C is cool without a big gap from outdoors, so you stay comfortable and catch fewer colds. Each degree lower makes the unit work much harder.

title.en: Why Should We Save Paper?

content.zh: 纸是木头做的，造一吨纸要砍十几棵树，还要用掉大量水和电。两面写、回收旧纸，都能少砍树。
content.en: Paper is made from wood: a tonne of it costs a dozen or more trees, plus lots of water and power. Using both sides and recycling saves trees.

title.en: Why Should Glass Bottles Be Recycled?

content.zh: 玻璃可以熔化再做成新瓶子，能反复用很多次，而造新玻璃要烧很高温的炉子，很费能源。回收能省下不少电。
content.en: Glass can be melted and remade again and again, while making new glass needs very hot furnaces and lots of energy. Recycling saves a great deal of power.

title.zh: 城市里为什么比郊区热
title.en: Why Are Cities Hotter Than the Countryside?

content.zh: 水泥和柏油白天吸饱了热，晚上慢慢放出来；再加上汽车、空调一起排热，城市就像盖了层棉被，这叫热岛效应。
content.en: Concrete and asphalt soak up heat by day and release it at night, while cars and air conditioners add more. The city sits under a warm blanket, called the heat island effect.

title.zh: 为什么要建自然保护区
title.en: Why Do We Set Up Nature Reserves?

content.zh: 保护区给动植物留下一块不被打扰的家，稀有物种才能活下来。这里还像一本活的教科书，让我们看到大自然本来的样子。
content.en: Reserves keep a patch of home where wildlife is left alone, so rare species survive. They are also living classrooms showing what nature looked like before.

title.zh: 地球上的水很多，为什么还要节约用水
title.en: If Earth Has So Much Water, Why Save It?

content.zh: 地球上的水绝大部分是咸海水，能喝的淡水只占很小一部分，而且分布不均。用起来不心疼，缺水的地方就会更多。
content.en: Almost all of Earth's water is salty sea, and only a tiny share is fresh to drink, spread very unevenly. Waste it and more places run short.

title.en: Can Tides Generate Electricity?

content.zh: 能。涨潮退潮时海水推着涡轮机转，就能发电。潮汐天天都有、可以预测，是一种很稳定的能源。
content.en: Yes. Moving water at high and low tide spins turbines to make power. Tides come every day and can be predicted, which makes them a steady source.

title.zh: 地下的热也能用来发电吗
title.en: Can Underground Heat Generate Power?

content.zh: 能。往地下打深井，把热水或蒸汽引上来推动汽轮机发电，这叫地热能。有些地方温泉多，正是地热在冒头。
content.en: Yes. Deep wells bring hot water or steam up to spin turbines, which is geothermal power. Where hot springs bubble up, that heat is close to the surface.

title.en: How Does a Nuclear Power Plant Work?

content.zh: 核电站用铀裂变放出大量的热把水烧成蒸汽，蒸汽推动汽轮机发电。它发电时不冒烟，但核废料要好好处理。
content.en: A plant uses the heat of splitting uranium to boil water into steam, and the steam spins a turbine. It makes no smoke, but the waste must be handled with great care.

title.zh: 电动汽车为什么更环保
title.en: Why Are Electric Cars Greener?

content.zh: 电动车自己不排尾气，跑起来更安静。要是电来自太阳能、风能这些干净电源，它比燃油车干净得多。
content.en: An electric car gives off no exhaust and runs quietly. When its power comes from sun or wind, it is far cleaner than a petrol car.

title.en: What Is a Shelter Forest For?

content.zh: 成排的树能把风挡住、把沙固定住，减少沙尘暴，还能保住土壤里的水。沙漠边缘种上防护林，田地就安全多了。
content.en: Rows of trees break the wind, hold sand in place and keep moisture in the soil. Planted along desert edges, they shield farmland from blowing sand.

title.en: Why Do Energy-Saving Bulbs Use Less Power?

content.zh: 节能灯把大部分电变成了光，只有一点点变成热；老式灯泡却大半白白烧成热。所以同样亮，用的电少得多。
content.en: A saving bulb turns most of its electricity into light and only a little into heat, while an old bulb wastes most as heat, so the same brightness costs far less.

title.en: Why Is Taking the Stairs Greener?

content.zh: 电梯要用电，爬楼用的是自己的力气。几层楼的距离走上去，既省电又锻炼身体，一举两得。
content.en: A lift runs on electricity while stairs run on you, so walking a few floors saves power and gives you exercise at the same time.

title.zh: 少吃肉对环境有帮助吗
title.en: Does Eating Less Meat Help the Environment?

content.zh: 养牛养羊要占大量土地和水，还会排出温室气体。少吃一点肉，就等于给地球省下不少资源。
content.en: Raising cattle and sheep takes huge amounts of land and water and gives off greenhouse gases, so eating a little less meat saves a lot of resources.

title.zh: 本地食物为什么更环保
title.en: Why Is Local Food Greener?

content.zh: 本地的菜不用长途运输和长期冷藏，省下大量燃油。买当季本地的，既新鲜又低碳。
content.en: Local produce needs no long haul or long cold storage, saving a great deal of fuel, so buying seasonal food nearby is fresher and lower in carbon.

title.zh: 为什么东西坏了要先修
title.en: Why Should We Repair Things First?

content.zh: 造一件新东西要采矿、运输、加工，很费资源。能修就修，少买一件，地球的负担就轻一分。
content.en: Making anything new means mining, shipping and processing, all costly in resources, so repairing and buying less takes a load off the planet.

title.zh: 为什么要交换和捐赠旧物
title.en: Why Swap and Donate Old Things?

content.zh: 你不要的东西别人正需要。交换和捐赠让物品继续被使用，既省下新资源，也少了一堆垃圾。
content.en: What you no longer want someone else needs, and swapping or donating keeps goods in use, saving new resources and cutting waste.

title.en: Why Is Cycling Good?

content.zh: 自行车不烧油、不排气，还能锻炼身体、不堵路。短途出行骑上它，又快又干净。
content.en: A bike burns no fuel and makes no exhaust, it keeps you fit and takes no space in traffic, so for short trips it is both quick and clean.

title.zh: 坐公交为什么比开车环保
title.en: Why Is the Bus Greener Than Driving?

content.zh: 一辆公交能载几十人，人均消耗的燃料比一人开一辆车少得多，路上占用的空间也小。
content.en: One bus carries dozens, using far less fuel per person than a car each and taking much less room on the road.

title.zh: 高铁为什么比飞机更环保
title.en: Why Are High-Speed Trains Greener Than Planes?

content.zh: 高铁用电、一次能载上千人，人均碳排放比飞机低得多。中短途坐高铁，又快又干净。
content.en: Trains run on electricity and carry over a thousand people, so per person they emit far less carbon than planes, and for medium trips they are fast and clean.

title.en: What Is a Green Building?

content.zh: 绿色建筑从设计到拆除都尽量省能源、省水、少产生垃圾，还会用太阳能和回收材料，住着也更舒服。
content.en: A green building saves energy and water and makes little waste from design to demolition, uses solar power and recycled materials, and is nicer to live in.

title.en: Why Grow Plants on a Roof?

content.zh: 屋顶的草能隔热，夏天楼里更凉、冬天更暖；还能吸住雨水、净化空气，给城市添一点绿。
content.en: Plants on a roof insulate the building, cooling it in summer and warming it in winter, and they hold rainwater, clean the air and add green to the city.

title.en: Why Should We Protect Bees?

content.zh: 蜜蜂给大部分农作物和野花传粉。没有它们，很多果树和蔬菜会结不出果实，我们的餐桌会空一大半。
content.en: Bees pollinate most crops and wild flowers, and without them many fruit trees and vegetables would set no food, emptying much of our plate.

title.en: Why Should We Protect Sharks?

content.zh: 鲨鱼是海里的顶级捕食者，把病弱的和多余的猎物清理掉，才能维持鱼群健康。它们少了，整个海洋都会失衡。
content.en: Sharks are top predators that remove the sick and weak and keep fish stocks healthy, and when they decline the whole sea falls out of balance.

title.zh: 为什么物种消失很危险
title.en: Why Is Losing Species Dangerous?

content.zh: 每种生物都在食物网里占一个位置，少了哪一种，依赖它的都得跟着遭殃。网破得越多，大自然越脆弱。
content.en: Every species holds a place in the food web, and lose one and all that depend on it suffer, so the more holes in the web the more fragile nature becomes.

title.en: What Does Carbon Neutral Mean?

content.zh: 把排出的二氧化碳和吸收掉的量抵消掉，净排放为零，就叫碳中和。种树、用清洁能源都能帮忙达到。
content.en: When the carbon dioxide released is balanced by the amount absorbed, net emissions are zero and that is carbon neutrality, helped by tree planting and clean energy.

title.en: What Is a Carbon Footprint?

content.zh: 碳足迹是你一天的生活产生的温室气体总量：坐车、用电、吃饭都算在内。知道它，才能想办法减少。
content.en: A carbon footprint is the total greenhouse gas your daily life produces, from travel, electricity and food, and knowing it is the first step to cutting it.

title.zh: 温室气体是怎么让地球变暖的
title.en: How Do Greenhouse Gases Warm the Earth?

content.zh: 它们像一层玻璃罩，让阳光进来，却把地球向外散的热挡住一部分。罩子越厚，地球就越热。
content.en: They act like a pane of glass, letting sunlight in while trapping some of the heat Earth sends back out, and the thicker the pane the warmer the planet.

title.zh: 臭氧层空洞是怎么回事
title.en: What Is the Ozone Hole?

content.zh: 高空有一层臭氧能挡住紫外线。某些制冷剂会破坏它，出现空洞。各国停用后，这个洞正在慢慢愈合。
content.en: A layer of ozone high up blocks ultraviolet light, and certain coolants damaged it, opening a hole that is slowly healing since countries banned those chemicals.

title.en: Where Does Haze Come From?

content.zh: 工厂、汽车和燃煤排出的细颗粒飘在空气中，遇到静稳天气散不掉，就聚成灰蒙蒙的雾霾。
content.en: Fine particles from factories, cars and coal burning hang in the air, and in still weather they cannot disperse and gather into grey haze.

title.en: Where Does Air Pollution Come From?

content.zh: 主要来自烧煤和石油、汽车尾气、工厂排放，还有扬尘和秸秆焚烧。这些混在一起，就成了脏空气。
content.en: It comes mainly from burning coal and oil, vehicle exhaust, factory emissions, plus dust and burning straw, and together they foul the air.

title.en: Is Noise a Kind of Pollution?

content.zh: 是。长期处在噪音里会让人睡不好、心烦、注意力下降，还会影响听力。安静也是一种需要保护的资源。
content.en: Yes. Living with noise harms sleep, raises stress and lowers concentration, and damages hearing, so quiet is a resource worth protecting too.

title.en: What Is Light Pollution?

content.zh: 夜里过亮的灯光会盖住星空，打乱人和动物的作息，还白白浪费电。把灯罩好、照向地面就能减轻。
content.en: Over-bright lights at night wash out the stars, upset the rhythms of people and animals and waste power, and shielding lamps and pointing them down helps.

title.en: How Is Dirty Water Cleaned?

content.zh: 污水先过滤掉大颗粒，再让微生物吃掉里面的有机物，最后消毒杀菌。处理干净的水才能排回河里。
content.en: Waste water is screened for solids, then microbes eat the organic matter and finally it is disinfected, and only clean water goes back to the river.

title.en: What Happens When Soil Is Damaged?

content.zh: 被污染或流失的土壤长不出庄稼，也存不住水，沙尘更容易扬起。恢复一厘米厚的土要几百上千年。
content.en: Polluted or washed-away soil grows no crops and holds no water, dust blows more easily, and rebuilding one centimetre of soil takes centuries.

title.zh: 砍树为什么会加剧变暖
title.en: Why Does Cutting Trees Make Warming Worse?

content.zh: 树活着时吸二氧化碳，砍掉烧掉又把碳放了回去。少了树吸收、多了碳排放，两头一起推着地球变热。
content.en: Living trees absorb carbon dioxide, and felling or burning them releases it again, so less absorption plus more emission pushes the planet warmer both ways.

title.en: What Is Sustainable Development?

content.zh: 就是满足今天的需要，又不把明天的资源用光。用可再生资源、少浪费，让后代也过得上好日子。
content.en: It means meeting today's needs without using up tomorrow's resources, relying on renewable sources and wasting less so later generations live well too.

title.zh: 小朋友能为地球做些什么
title.en: What Can Children Do for the Planet?

content.zh: 随手关灯、节约用水、垃圾分类、少用一次性用品，还可以种一棵树、提醒家人。小事攒起来很可观。
content.en: Switch off lights, save water, sort rubbish, avoid disposables, plant a tree and remind your family, because small acts add up to a lot.

title.zh: 为什么要发展可再生能源
title.en: Why Develop Renewable Energy?

content.zh: 煤和石油烧完就没了，还会污染。太阳能、风能、水能取之不尽，也不冒烟，是长久的能源。
content.en: Coal and oil run out and pollute, while sun, wind and water never run short and give off no smoke, making them energy for the long run.

title.zh: 太阳能板为什么要朝向太阳
title.en: Why Should Solar Panels Face the Sun?

content.zh: 正对着太阳时接收到的光最多，发电也最多。所以北半球的太阳能板通常朝南、还要倾斜一个角度。
content.en: Facing the sun squarely catches the most light and makes the most power, so in the northern hemisphere panels usually face south at a tilt.

title.zh: 风力发电机为什么有三个叶片
title.en: Why Do Wind Turbines Have Three Blades?

content.zh: 三个叶片转动平稳、受力均匀，噪音也小，材料和效率刚好平衡。多了更贵更重，少了转得不够稳。
content.en: Three blades turn smoothly with balanced forces and little noise, striking the best balance of material and efficiency, since more cost extra and fewer run less steadily.

title.en: How Do Dams Affect Fish?

content.zh: 大坝挡住了洄游鱼类的去路，让它们回不到产卵地。现在许多大坝会专门修鱼道，帮鱼绕过去。
content.en: A dam blocks migrating fish from reaching spawning grounds, and many dams now build fish passes to help them get around.

title.en: Can Hydrogen Be Used as Fuel?

content.zh: 能。氢气燃烧只生成水，一点不脏。难处是制取和储存成本高，所以还在推广当中。
content.en: Yes, since burning hydrogen gives only water and nothing dirty, though making and storing it is still costly, so it is only slowly spreading.

title.en: Where Does Our Rubbish Go?

content.zh: 分好类的垃圾各有去处：能回收的再造成新东西，厨余堆肥，剩下的才焚烧发电或填埋。
content.en: Sorted rubbish goes its own way: recyclables become new goods, food waste becomes compost, and only the rest is burnt for energy or buried.

title.zh: 厨余垃圾怎么变成肥料
title.en: How Does Food Waste Become Compost?

content.zh: 菜叶果皮在通气湿润的环境里被微生物分解，几个月就变成黑褐色的腐殖土，正好用来种花种菜。
content.en: Peelings and leaves are broken down by microbes where air and moisture reach them, becoming dark humus in months, ideal for flowers and vegetables.

title.en: Can Old Clothes Be Recycled?

content.zh: 能。完好干净的可以捐给别人，破的可以剪成抹布，或者打碎重新纺成纤维，做成新布料和保温材料。
content.en: Yes. Clean, whole clothes can be donated, torn ones cut into cloths, and others shredded back into fibre for new fabric or insulation.

title.zh: 为什么要拒绝过度包装
title.en: Why Refuse Excess Packaging?

content.zh: 包装只用一次就扔，造它却要耗材料、耗能源，还多半成了垃圾。简装和自带购物袋最实在。
content.en: Packaging is thrown away after one use yet costs materials and energy to make and mostly becomes waste, so simple wraps and your own bag are best.
